title: Issue with XInput spamming the output/terminal on Linux with a 4.4.1 build (related to wayland)
body:
### Tested versions

4.4.1 (latest stable). I have the issue both with normal version and with custom build (GodotSteam). v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6] and v4.4.1.stable.custom_build [9a3480ff1]

I tried it with Godot 4.5.1 Dev Snapshot and I still have it. v4.5.dev3.official [28089c40c]

Keep in mind I'm updating my project to Godot 4.4 from Godot 3.6. I didn't have this issue in Godot 3.6. 

On my Windows machine, I don't have this issue. I switch between computers since I work from two places. My other machine is Windows 10, ASUS Laptop. 

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable (9a3480ff1) - Ubuntu 22.04.3 LTS 22.04 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - SVGA3D; build: RELEASE;  LLVM; - Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-9400F CPU @ 2.90GHz (2 threads)

### Issue description

I get spammed with three messages non-stop as I try to work in my console:
```
XInput: Refreshing devices.
XInput: Absolute pointing device: xwayland-pointer:16
XInput: No touch devices found.
```

### Steps to reproduce

- Open my project in Godot (with my version and system)
- Do anything
- Check the editor output, it's full of messages. 
Basically it prints out at every action the three things I put up there. Just opening it will create about 828. 

The terminal doesn't print it when I open Godot (i.e. project manager), just when a project is opened. 

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

- A brand new project does not have this issue. I cannot provide a minimal project as my game is already tens of thousands of lines of Code and I have 0 clue where this starts. 
- I'm doing a refactoring as I'm updating from 3.6 (I didn't use the automatic project update tool), so I'm basically recreating every file from scratch in 4.4 (I'm refactoring my code so it works better). Since my game has tens of thousands of lines of code, I can't tell you when this started, or for what reason. I don't have any plugins messing with inputs. I could provide my whole repo in private if it's useful. 
- The project has no wayland options and no input settings in the project settings for now. The project is in Compatibility. 

Thank you for your work.
